invariant: worker identity and action ownership are established only by successful creation of unique Git refs; existing refs are collisions, never adoptable identities

protocols.worker_registration: try worker slot branches W1→W4; first create_branch success wins; then add immutable worker marker file to that branch and retain resulting registration_commit
protocols.action_claim: try action claim branches A→D; create each candidate claim branch directly from caller registration_commit; first create_branch success atomically assigns action to that worker
protocols.ownership_resolution: action claim branch head must be caller registration_commit or a descendant preserving caller worker marker; existing action claim branch belongs to its creator and may never be adopted
